page.label: Welcome to Archie's Dino Mod! This is your guide to learning anything and everything about the new creatures living in your world!
To navigate, hover and interact with anything with a white outline.
To open the book to a specific dino's just click on desired categories!
Press to close the guide book!
Nobody knows what fell from the sky that night. What we know: the shards are warm. Always warm. Like something inside them is still alive.
Look for scorched craters in the lands where the creatures roam, and for ancient bones resting in the deserts and badlands. Where the amber fell, something old is near.
Mine the ore, and keep a shard on you. The creatures are drawn to it. Nobody can say why. But whoever carries amber never searches for long.
Archie pays well for every shard you bring him. He says it's for his research. The refined amber can be cut and built like stone, if you can spare it.
And one more thing. Those who truly master a creature learn to cast its likeness in amber.
A Totem, they call it. Proof that you did not hunt it, did not cage it, but earned it.
Herbivore
Biome
Dripstone Caves
Lush Caves
Drops
Lush Core
The Lushsaur is a reclusive herbivore of the Lush and Dripstone caves. It blends into its surroundings when undisturbed, revealing itself only to those who earn its trust.
Becomes invisible when resting. When tamed, it disables this ability.
Tail stomp to keep enemies at a distance.
Charge attack to rush targets with follow-up attacks.
High chance to deflect projectiles.
Headbutt attack that dazes and breaks terrain.
Tail swing attack with wide knockback.
The Lushsaur only responds if you are patient.
You must keep offering Glow Berries until it accepts you.
It will not respond while it's camouflaged, or actively avoiding danger.
Once tamed, it becomes calm instead of wary, so you can safely interact with it.

Breeding is done by feeding Glow Berries on two tamed adult Lushsaurs. An egg will then be laid on the ground. You can pick up the egg by interacting with it. Lushsaur Eggs are tough, and doesn't need special care to hatch other than grass or moss blocks under them.

Hatching time can be reduced when there are adult Lushsaurs nearby.
Once hatched, growth can be sped up by feeding it Glow Berries.
Upon growing to adulthood, the Lushsaur will shed its Lush Core. It will slowly grow back over time.
Once tamed, Lushsaurs no longer enter camouflage. Instead, it will sleep and wake up on regular intervals, staying fully visible the whole time.
The Lushsaur can be saddled and ridden through caves. Its attacks can break terrain, letting you carve your own paths.
→ Headbutt (breaks terrain)
→ Swing (knockback / breaks vegetation)
You can feed it Glow Berries while riding to give it a momentary speed boost.
The Lush Mace can be crafted using the Lush Core acquired from breeding or defeating the Lushsaur.

container.label: Spin Attack (30s ⌚)
Knock away all entities around the player.

page.label: You can craft Lushsaur armor using Lush Cores.

container.label: → Full Set Bonus:
Grants Resistance I
→ Special: Camouflage
Sneaking while moving gives mobs a chance to ignore you. Standing still makes you completely undetectable.

Drops
Mossy Claw

The Therimoss is a slow, towering giant that lives deep in the jungle. It calmly makes its way through the vegetation, sometimes seen leaning against tree trunks or climbing partway up to look at the world below.
Can leap from the ground into the treetops.
Can climb trees and break foliage.
A heavy impact attack that buries targets.
A close range triple swipe attack.
Hurls a dirt block, dealing ranged damage.
Be careful when breaking logs, as it hates deforestation.
The Therimoss only takes interest in large offerings. Players must construct a 4x4 pyramid (20 blocks) made entirely of food items to attract its attention.

• Melon
• Pumpkin
• Cake
• Bamboo Block
• Azalea Leaves
• Mushroom Block
Once it begins eating, the player may feed it Bamboo again to tame it. Each interaction has a chance to succeed, requiring patience and preparation.
Breeding is done by feeding Bamboo on two tamed adult Therimoss.
An egg will be laid on the ground, which can be picked up by interacting with it. Therimoss Eggs hatch easily with no special care.
Once hatched, the baby Therimoss can be fed the same food items used in the pyramid to speed up its growth.
When tamed, the Therimoss becomes calm and responsive.
The Therimoss is a powerful exploration mount, improving travel through difficult terrain.
→ Leap up onto treetops.
Climb → Climb up trees breaking foliage upon command.
→ A close range triple swipe attack.
→ Hurls a dirt block, dealing ranged damage to the closest enemy.
The Theri Claws can be crafted using Mossy Claws, which can be harvested by shearing Therimoss or obtained by defeating them.
While falling near a wall you can slide down safely.
You can craft the Therimoss armor set with Mossy Claws.

container.label: → Full Set Bonus:
Grants reduced food consumption.
→ Special: Swift (10s ⌚)
Press to activate a speed boost.

The Coralosaur is a colossal deep-sea guardian found roaming around the depths of the ocean, sometimes buried beneath the warm seabed. It lies dormant until a faint disturbance in the sand reveals where something enormous rests.
Emits a bubble stream that replenishes oxygen.
Retreats and repositions under the seabed when threats are too far away.
When equipped with a saddle, it allows boats to be attached to it with leads.
Large storage, expandable by interacting with it using chests.
Forward bite that deals damage in a wide arc.
Commands nearby ocean life to defend you.
To tame a Coralosaur, find its buried head by following the bubble trail.
You must keep offering it Coral Stews until it accepts you.
Once you succeed, the Coralosaur then awakens into a bonded state, no longer sleeping under the seabed.
Breeding is done by feeding two tamed adult Coralosaurs with any piece of coral or Coral Stews.
A baby coralosaur will spawn afterwards. Coralosaurs grow underwater, and their growth can be sped up by feeding them Coral Stew or any fish.
The Coralosaur can lead boats, and has an expandable storage system by adding chests to the saddle. You can remove the saddle using shears.
→ Forward bite that deals damage in a wide arc.
→ Commands nearby ocean life to defend you.

The Rib Bow can be crafted using Coral Ribs from defeated Coralosaurs.
Arrows fired from the Rib Bow have very little arrow drop when underwater.
You can craft the Coralosaur armor set with Coral Ribs.

container.label: → Full Set Bonus:
Grants Swim Speed, Underwater Mining Haste & Conduit Power when underwater
→ Special: Marine Command (4s ⌚)
Press to summon sea creatures to fight for you when in water.

Obsidian Horn
The Obsidiceratops is a superheated tank with a large appetite for lava. It rarely wanders far from the lava oceans of the Nether.
Be careful if you spot one. It stays calm when full of lava, but gets dangerous when its supply runs low.
Seeks out lava pools to refill its lava supply.
Can store lava and give it to the player once tamed.
Has a built-in, single-chest worth of storage.
Headbutts, dealing a heavy close range attack.
A Tail Whip attack with heavy knockback.
Can be stunned for a short time by blowing an Obsidian Horn near it.
Obsidiceratopses can only be tamed while they are calm, and require 14–25 Magma Blocks to win their trust.
You must keep their lava level high while taming them, as letting it run too low will cause you to lose your progress.
Once tamed, the Obsidiceratops can be saddled and ridden.

Breeding is done by feeding Magma Blocks to two tamed adult Obsidiceratopses.
An Obsidiceratops Egg will then be laid on the ground, which can be picked up.
The egg can be picked up, but deals burn damage on contact.
It must be kept close to lava to incubate, or else it will break.
The Obsidiceratops is a strong mount, able to transport both lava and items throughout your journey in the Nether.
Lava Storage → Can hold up to 15 buckets of lava.
Refill → Interact with a lava bucket to replenish lava.
→ Headbutt for a close range attack.
→ Tail Whip attack with heavy knockback.
The Scorching Horn can be crafted with Obsidian Horns acquired from defeating Obsidiceratopses.

container.label: Summon Pets (5s ⌚)
Using the Scorching Horn allows you to summon your pets.

page.label: You can craft the Obsidiceratops armor set with Obsidian Horns.

Biome
Deep Dark
Drops
Raptor Talon
Sculkraptors are restless predators that stalk the Deep Dark in packs, drawn to any sound or movement. Alone, it avoids fighting, but in numbers, it becomes far more dangerous.
Only fights when in groups.
Finds targets through vibrations and sound.
Ranged projectile attack that has a chance to inflict poison.
When in a pack, it emits a deafening scream attack that knocks back and dazes.
Marks targets for other Deep Dark monsters to attack.
Wild Sculkraptors cannot be tamed directly. Instead, you must find their nest, where packs usually gather.
Getting close to the nest alerts nearby Sculkraptors, and they will attack to defend their eggs.
Once you defeat them all, you can now take the Sculkraptor Egg from the nest. Each nest can only give one viable egg good enough to hatch.
Sculkraptor Eggs must be kept somewhere dark to incubate.
A tamed baby Sculkraptor will emerge when the egg hatches, and it will follow you wherever you go.
You can help it grow faster by feeding it monster drops, like rotten flesh, spider eyes, or bones.
You can rally tamed Sculkraptors to wherever you are aiming using a Raptor Talon (30s ⌚), which is acquired by defeating wild Sculkraptors.
Tamed Sculkraptors will only target enemies hit by a Sculk Tipped Arrow fired from the Sculk Bow. The pack will focus its attacks on marked targets.
The Sculkraptors' projectiles also have a chance to mark players hit, allowing other Deep Dark monsters to target them.

Sculkraptors are strongest in numbers, and only commit to a fight when they have others backing them up. When several of them attack together, they can let out a scream that knocks enemies back and dazes them. Alongside melee bites, they also have a ranged toxic attack that can poison enemies.

Biome

Drops
Chorus Fossil
The Chorusoatl is a graceful End-dwelling flier that drifts in groups across the outer End Islands. When threatened, the flock fights back with a powerful screech and overwhelming attacks.
Untamed groups attack together.
Has a powerful screech attack that knocks enemies back.
When equipped with a saddle, allows the player to take flight.
A close range bite attack.
A ranged energy attack which can blow away enemies.
Chorusoatls are rarely alone. To tame one, you must first separate it from its flock using a Chorus Fruit.

Holding a Chorus Fruit will prevent it from flying off right away.
If you approach without it, the Chorusoatl will warn you once before attacking.
Although even if you manage to feed it, there's a chance it will reject you, screech, and fly off instead.
Once tamed, the Chorusoatl can be saddled and ridden.

Breeding is done by feeding Chorus Fruits to two tamed adult Chorusoatls. A Chorusoatl Egg will then be laid on the ground, which can be picked up, although it's fragile and will break if handled too often.

The egg incubates best in the End, but can hatch elsewhere too, requiring complete darkness and End Stone below and Chorus Plants nearby. Once hatched, you can feed it Chorus Fruit to speed up growth.
The Chorusoatl can be saddled, which lets you fly freely across the End Islands.
→ Take off and land
→ A close range bite attack.
→ A ranged energy spit attack.
The Chorus Scythe can be crafted with Chorus Fossils acquired from defeating Chorusoatls.

The Sculksaur is the apex predator of the Deep Dark. Even the Warden is no match for its rampage.

→ Spawns shortly after a Warden emerges.
→ Extremely aggressive.
→ Especially hostile towards the Warden.
→ Untameable and cannot be bred.
Waking this monster will end badly for you. It consumes the world around it, attacking anything it can sense.
You have been warned.
Gains a huge damage boost upon spawn, which can overpower Wardens.
Finds players by sound, vibrations, and smell.
A powerful bite attack dealing high damage.
A Tail Whip that deals damage and knockback.
Unleashes a deafening roar that deals sonic damage.
Shooting the warts on the Sculksaur's side with arrows will make it drop Sculk Toxins, a material used to craft Sculk equipment.

→ Inflicts Darkness and Poison.
→ Highly damaging against Deep Dark mobs.
You can craft the Sculksaur armor set with Sculk Toxins.
